# Income booked in two currencies, which is what makes a consolidated income
# statement need a rate: the CAD side needs none, the USD side needs one for
# every period it appears in.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Exports
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-03-01 * "Domestic sale"
	Assets:Bank 100.00 CAD
	Income:Sales -100.00 CAD

2026-03-02 * "Export sale"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank USD 200.00 USD
	Income:Exports -200.00 USD
